newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish authorities approve cheaper Losec sales.
newsitem.headline: Swedish authorities approve cheaper Losec sales.

text.p: Drugs importer Cross-Pharma on Friday said it would sell Losec in Sweden from the end of the year at prices between ten to 16 percent under that of Astra which manufactures the ulcer treatment drug.

Sweden's National Social Insurance Board (RFV) has fixed the prices for Cross-Pharma's parallel imports of Losec, said Bo Gunnarsson of the state-owned Apoteksbolaget that controls drug sales in Sweden.
"We have received information from RFV that these prices will start to take effect from the year end," Gunnarsson told Reuters.
Losec is marketed as Prilosec in the U.S..
